people.name: Aaron
people.line: Moses' brother, first high priest of Israel

people.name: Moses
people.line: Prophet who led Israel out of Egypt

people.name: Samuel
people.line: Prophet and last judge of Israel before the kings

translations.web: Moses and Aaron were among his priests, Samuel was among those who call on his name. They called on Yahweh, and he answered them.
translations.bsb: Moses and Aaron were among His priests; Samuel was among those who called on His name. They called to the LORD and He answered.
translations.kjv: Moses and Aaron among his priests, and Samuel among them that call upon his name; they called upon the LORD, and he answered
translations.asv: Moses and Aaron among his priests, And Samuel among them that call upon his name; They called upon Jehovah, and he answered them.
